row.body: The house list calls the yards secure, but a tied garbage bag contains the last gate latch and a note to check behind each fence.
row.title: Backyard clearing list

sidecar.gloss: A secure-house list still calls for a second check behind the fences.
sidecar.rival_reading: A grounds crew could have bagged a damaged latch during routine work; the list does not prove anyone was left exposed.
